io.github.shrinivas93:rest-in-peace-reactor 1.0.0.62 发布, Project Reactor CallAdapterFactory implementations for REST-in-peace -
		Mono<T> and Flux<T> return-type support, including a
		backpressure-aware Flux<T> over @Paginated methods.
		See docs/design/reactor-call-adapter.md in the parent repository for
		the full design and rollout plan. A sibling reactor module of core/
		(not a dependent of it in the reactor sense - it resolves core the
		same way a real downstream consumer would, as an ordinary Maven
		dependency), sharing core's version and release cadence via their
		common parent. Targets Java 8, matching core, since this module adds
		no framework requirement of its own beyond reactor-core itself
		(unlike rest-in-peace-spring-boot-starter, which needs Java 17+ for
		Spring Boot 4.x).

		@RestClient interface found on the classpath as a Spring bean, instead
		of one hand-written @Bean method per interface. See
		docs/design/spring-boot-starter.md in the parent repository for the
		full design and rollout plan. A sibling reactor module of core/ (not
		a dependent of it in the reactor sense - it resolves core the same
		way a real downstream consumer would, as an ordinary Maven
		dependency), sharing core's version and release cadence via their
		common parent. Requires Java 17+ and Spring Boot 4.x; the core
		rest-in-peace library itself stays on Java 8.
